short: A long-range American strategic bomber that has served as a core component of the United States' nuclear triad since 1955.
full:
Entering service in 1955, the Boeing B-52 Stratofortress was designed to carry nuclear weapons deep into Soviet territory during the Cold War. Powered by eight turbojet engines, its swept-wing design gave it a massive payload capacity and intercontinental range. As Soviet air defenses evolved, the B-52 transitioned from high-altitude nuclear deterrence to low-level penetration and conventional bombing, most notably launching devastating strikes during the Vietnam War.

Despite its age, the B-52 has proven extraordinarily adaptable. It has been continually upgraded with advanced avionics, precision-guided munitions, and cruise missiles, allowing it to remain highly effective in modern conflicts like the Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It is projected to remain in active service into the 2050s, nearly a century after its first flight.
